name: Foot Pincer

stealth.note: (trained); @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] when the bat swarm is active

description: A metal pincer trap lies hidden at the bottom of a weakened spot in the floor.
disable: DC 17 Thievery to jam the pincer's triggeer mechanism.
reset: The foot pincer must be reset manually before it can activate again.

generalAbilities.name: Slam Shut
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto a foot pincer

Effect The trap slams shut on the triggering creature's foot. The creature must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save or take (1d6+5) Slashing Damage damage and 1d4 Bleed Damage.
